kind: coding agent and programmable local workflow/team runtime

runtime.execution: Node multi-host LlmClient and shared tool scheduler; fresh separate QuickJS host for exec; node:vm workflow orchestration and local AgentHeadless workers; shell processes and managed/legacy session writers.
runtime.service_boundary: Consumes providers, MCP and optional wrapped execution environments; owns local code-mode/workflow compute, teams/mailboxes/background registries and chosen session authority. Consumer/store abstractions exist but do not establish an independent shared kernel fabric.

summary: Independently evolved Qwen Code snapshot has actual code/workflow programs, model messaging and team routing, projected context and optional commit-fenced managed state. Its freshness, mailbox retention, best-effort reload and declared-domain boundaries prevent treating these as full audit or executable refit.

inspection.scope: Selected source excerpts trace exposed entry/loop/request/action/result/state boundaries and relevant capability mechanisms; listed tests are read as source only.
inspection.limits: No acquired code executed, dependencies installed or live providers invoked. Claims concern this pinned snapshot; untraced catalog tools and dependency internals are not inferred.

actions.name: read_file / write_file / edit
actions.lifecycle: read cache tracks actual residency; write checks prior read/runtime version/abort; edit name/catalog only

actions.name: run_shell_command
actions.output: foreground results or task ID/PID/output file
actions.lifecycle: owned process registration; background settlement awaits output flush; orphan registration requests abort
actions.authority: model under scheduler execution policy; task_stop catalog available

actions.name: exec
actions.lifecycle: separate fresh QuickJS host each call; framed dispatch/CPU/memory/wall limits; cancels child/nested work
actions.authority: model via audited runtime only; no direct host I/O/import

actions.name: tool_search / tool_call
actions.lifecycle: lazy registration; bridge must dispatch via scheduler, not direct run

actions.name: workflow
actions.lifecycle: bounded real AgentHeadless dispatch through node:vm orchestration; journal replay longest unchanged prefix; background only TUI/completion channel
actions.authority: model configurable workflows; saved scope/name-only gates; description requires operator requested orchestration

actions.name: agent
actions.lifecycle: background registry records abort/controller and continuation reason; selected-model teammate route separately tested
actions.authority: model/configured child/tool policy; production workflow denies selected backchannels

actions.name: send_message
actions.output: queued/resumed/continued/peer sent or error; no inline answer
actions.lifecycle: running task at tool-round boundary; completed resident continuation vs cold revival; peer recipients can hold messages
actions.authority: default ask; peer text explicitly carries no sender user authority

actions.name: team_create / team_delete / team_plan_approval
actions.lifecycle: enabled registry only; detailed create/delete internals not traced; actual delivery/route below
actions.authority: config flag; leader-only shutdown omitted from child registry

actions.name: LocalManagedSessionAuthority.open / commit
actions.lifecycle: serialized transaction marker before application, failed append poisons writer; cold proof checks
actions.authority: declared actors/session fences under configured managed-mode binding

actions.name: recorder close / sealForHandoff

actions.name: SkillManager filesystem refresh / listeners
actions.lifecycle: 150ms debounce; registry mutates before listeners, 30s cap may leave slow listener finishing later
actions.authority: host skill manager/model edits authorized files through ordinary tools

actions.name: SessionService.searchSessionContent
actions.lifecycle: bounded scan with cancellation/yield; transcript-domain query
actions.authority: host/session consumers, not a full effect audit query

filesystem.detail: Native read/write runtime paths support media/ranges, residency-aware caching and prior-read/version checks; native edit catalog separately scoped.

processes.detail: Foreground/background owned shell registry gives stable task/PID/output file; orphan register aborts and terminal status waits for output flush. Shell stop operation is cataloged but internals untraced.

code_actions.detail: Fresh code-mode QuickJS programs compose registered tool calls through audited scheduler; direct file/process tool paths and node:vm workflow programs are distinct.

persistent_kernel.detail: Code-mode creates new QuickJS runtime/context for each call and fresh-global test confirms no namespace continuity. Workflow VM can retain variables only for its run; no shared resident language kernel established.

standing_database.detail: Declared managed-session journal/authority and queryable session transcripts are standing state primitives, not model general SQL or independent shared computation fabric.

workflow_programming.detail: Enabled native workflow executes model-authored/saved JavaScript with agent/parallel/pipeline/nested composition, stable run/journal IDs and bounded real production dispatch. Code-mode separately composes ordinary tools.

multi_model.detail: Request model overrides and definition-driven child/team generator routes are wired. Mock route test checks separate provider view; no live quality guarantee inferred.

live_collaboration.detail: Model send_message routes running/paused/resident background tasks, teams and same-machine peer adapter. Team recipient queues drain idle with provenance/backpressure; peer transport internals untraced and receiver may hold messages.

concurrent_work.detail: Shared safe-kind predicate batches reads/read-only shells/agents and serializes unsafe calls/skill activation; workflow dispatch adds bounded concurrency and separate agent attempts.

steering_interrupt.detail: Steer callback preserves input on abort and combines pending steer with Stop continuation; provider child signals, code host termination, task messages and background controller identities traced. Full all-program quiescence not established.

turn_redefinition.detail: Message types, Stop-hook forced continuation/model override/steer callbacks plus code/workflow programs expose meaningful turn composition. Fixed host send loop remains; no arbitrary model-owned scheduler replacement established.

compaction.detail: Auto/manual compression appends projection snapshot with tool/prompt identities, swaps active history and clears stale file-read/execution cache; fast rule-based client path exists but internals not covered here.

context_repair.detail: Original transcript vs appended compressed snapshot and explicit cache invalidation enable recomposition; re-read restores file contents rather than returning stale unchanged. No dedicated native model historical-context repair protocol traced.

original_audit.detail: Managed declared events have sequence/digest/commit proof and raw conversation projections append rather than overwrite. Non-strict unsupported records can drop, write failure disables ordinary writes, mailboxes expire read messages; full provider/OS-effect capture not established.

audit_query.detail: Managed readEvents/commit receipt cold reopen and bounded session-content search are actual query primitives; event domains and materialized transcript are narrower than all-effect audit.

hot_change.detail: Saved workflow scripts load per call; skill watcher debounces and awaits best-effort derived refresh. Registry mutates before listeners and timeout can release a still-running listener; no affected-workflow versioned activation contract established.

rebuild_continuity.detail: Managed recorder seals writer proof and cold successor validates it; workflow journal resumes unchanged-prefix agent results and background cold revival uses transcript. No compiled executable outpost/refit or owned-standing pause barrier traced.

remote_services.detail: Consumes configured content generators/compatible remote provider stream and environment-wrapped tools; managed authority can use abstract journal handle. Inspected code-mode/workflow/shell compute is locally harness owned.

self_improvement.detail: Model-authored/saved workflows plus measured dispatch token budgets and ordinary editing can compose experiments. No dedicated model-governed self-change acceptance/refit loop proven by inspected paths or README self-iteration claim.

complaints.detail: No nonfatal native agent-state grievance filing into independent database established in inspected tools/recording/workflow/team paths; report_findings catalog name is not treated as complaint.

authority.detail: Scheduler safety classification, declared managed actors/fences, prior-read/version checks, experimental leader-only registration and send_message default ask are explicit scopes. Peer text cannot inherit sender operator authority.

evaluation.detail: Read tests cover fresh guest globals/cancel, filesystem-backed commit/reopen/idempotence, mock provider route and SIGKILL journal replacement. Strong persistence oracle scopes do not prove real provider/OS exactly-once or complete context semantics; not run.

time_order.detail: Declared managed events commit ordered sequence/digest prefix with actor fences; background exit timestamp captured before flush while status waits; mailbox timestamp/priority delivery separate clocks. No external effect global order inferred.

OpenAI-compatible stream uses child AbortController and actual SDK request; HTTP response metadata inspected before converted stream.
Shared concurrency predicate excludes skill activation, admits agents, and admits shell only when conservatively read-only.
Scheduler gates all calls ready and executes consecutive safe groups or sequential unsafe operations.
Native catalog includes exec, file/shell, agents/messages/teams, tasks, workflows, memory and goals; names alone do not prove every implementation.
Exec is dynamically registered only in CodeModeOnly tool mode.
Actual registry wires tool_call/search, agent/list/task_stop and send_message.
Experimental team flag registers team_create/delete/plan approval; leader-only shutdown is excluded from child registries.
Read has resident-history-aware file cache, excludes nested code-mode cache fast path and calls cancellable media/text processor.
Write captures runtime version, checks shared-memory secrets and enforces prior-read before existing-content read.
Final version decision can reject TOCTOU, creates directories after check and passes version/abort to actual runtime write.
Background shell registers stable ID/PID/output file, aborts on orphan registration, and marks terminal status only after output stream flush.
Exec requires audited runtime and uses scheduler dispatch for nested calls; terminal-goal metadata gates further work.
Code-mode spawns separate host with framed messages; tracks nested controllers and terminates child/nested work on abort or wall timeout.
Each request constructs QuickJS runtime/context with memory/stack/CPU budget; not a resident kernel.
Model-facing code-mode contract describes nested tool functions/helpers and fresh isolated runtime without direct filesystem/network/imports.
Workflow accepts inline/path/name,args,resume run ID/background; saved script loaded per call; globals compose agents/phases/parallel/pipeline/nesting.
Actual WorkflowRunner admission returns stable runId/script/journal handle for background or awaits completion for foreground.
Workflow tool actual registration is gated on workflows enabled.
Runner selects production dispatch unless test injection; uses same controller and token budget with approval event bridge.
Run handle links bounded dispatch scheduler, controller,budget,registry and orchestration with journal/resumeReplay.
Production dispatch actually creates AgentHeadless with bounded turns/time and denied message/plan control backchannels.
Workflow runs node:vm context; globals constructed in guest realm, random/time disabled for replay determinism.
Workflow resume ID validates; background requires interactive TUI and completion channel.
send_message is a privileged instruction sink with default ask, not inherited sender authority.
Peer route calls same-machine peer transport, handles ambiguity/errors and marks received text as cross-session without sender user authority; transport internals untraced.
Paused task can resume and completed resident task continues before transcript cold-revive fallback; restored sessions do not retain resident runtime.
Running background messages queue at next tool-round boundary, with completion notification rather than inline reply.
Teammate-to-leader actual mailbox write/timestamp and shutdown-response reservation; accepted approved shutdown can abort sender.
Team peer messages queue with bounded backpressure and immediately flush only when recipient idle.
Delivery prioritizes queue and wraps provenance then enqueues within teammate AsyncLocalStorage identity.
Inbox uses lock+atomic rewrite and marks reads; read messages older than five minutes compact out, unread stay.
Background agent registry records model/lineage/output/abort identity and continuation-block reason.
When managed mode chosen, config opens authority and binds recorder managed sink before activation under asserted writer lease.
Cold open validates committed sequence/digest handoff proof and refuses uncommitted tail without exclusive repair.
Commit checks expected sequence, same-command content digest/idempotent receipt and session/actor fence.
Declared events and commit marker append as transaction before in-memory application; append failure poisons further writer and does not imply external effects atomically committed.
Managed/legacy record writes serialize; unsupported managed records can be dropped on non-strict path; write failure degrades recorder and later ordinary writes become no-ops.
Recorder close flushes and seals managed writer with commit proof after stopAdvancing; failed nonmanaged handoff retains lock; not executable compile/outpost.
Compression records snapshot/completed tool IDs then changes history, clears file-read cache and invalidates execution cache after successful compaction.
Compression appends distinct system record preserving projection/prompt IDs rather than rewriting transcript originals.
Manual compression carries completed IDs/start context and forces full IDE context; clears stale read placeholders.
Skill activation mutates registry before parallel change listeners; hung listeners capped at 30s and can finish later—best effort activation consistency.
Filesystem skill watcher debounces refresh 150ms and updates watchers from refreshed cache.
Session content search has bounded file/result defaults, whitespace/case folding and cancellation/yield scanning.
Real code-mode host test checks fresh globals and mock nested unawaited cancellation; not persistent state.
Filesystem fixture test checks input/wake transaction, cold reopen and command-id replay receipts; not model/provider/OS effect exact-once.
Mocked generator/core tests validate teammate dedicated provider route/runtimeView vs leader.
Restart test prepares fake journal records and child writer to target kill before/after rename.
SIGKILL and reload oracle checks retained prefix/result/start sets across atomic rename, not real provider side effects.

tests.focus: Fresh guest globals and unfinished nested call cancellation
tests.oracle: Uses actual host runner with mocked nested function; confirms no persisted global and abort event, not OS/provider termination convergence.

tests.focus: Durable input/wake transaction, cold reopen and idempotent command replay
tests.oracle: Filesystem fixture asserts declared records/receipt counts before and after reopen; no external provider/process effect atomicity.
Mocks content generator/core; asserts selected route and separation from leader, not live provider collaboration quality.
SIGKILL child before/after rename, load retained fake prefix/result/start records; attacks torn persistence, not uncertainty of real tool effects.

strengths: Two distinct model programming surfaces: audited ordinary-tool QuickJS programs and agent-oriented saved/resumable workflows.
Actual live session/team messaging with explicit handles, provenance, receiver authority and bounded delivery rules.
Managed journal explicitly fences actor/sequence/content and distinguishes committed prefix from torn tail; integration is actual optional config binding.
Compaction cache invalidation understands that an unchanged-file placeholder is invalid once its original context is no longer resident.
Background shell status reflects flushed output rather than announcing terminal state while disk bytes remain pending.
limits: Breadth is large; this study traces representative reachable mechanics, not every media/tool/goal/thread/host implementation. Managed mode and experimental teams are explicitly conditional.
Code-mode is fresh per call, workflow globals per run; neither proves standing shared language kernel.
Team peer messages wait for idle, task messages wait tool boundary, same-machine peer adapter may hold text; mailbox read records expire after five minutes.
Managed commits cover declared records, not all transport/OS effects; non-strict dropped records and degraded writer are material completeness limits.
Writer proof handoff and workflow prefix replay are supporting continuity; no quiescent compilation/outpost with owned standing pause traced.
Skill registry mutates before best-effort listener refresh; timeout can leave partially refreshed consumers.
arconaut_questions: Treat model programs, workflows and participant state as scoped consumers while deciding which primitives belong to fabric rather than Arconaut ownership.
Can preserved original history plus residency markers make model-initiated context repair reproducible and auditable?
Which declared event domains and uncertain effects must join the immutable audit rather than remaining sidecars, expiry mailboxes or best-effort records?
Build Arconaut quiescence/refit proof above—not equivalent to—writer-seal commit proof and longest-prefix workflow replay.
Keep operator-governed authority distinct from peer claims while making sustained multi-model messaging and model orchestration normal work.
